text:
Priya: Heads up 1: customer asks for a phased EU+APAC rollout but with explicit token-budget safety. Need a minimal spec we can hand to infra + SRE.
Chris: Proposal: two-stage canary + A/B economics test. Stage 1 = functional canary (0.5% global, region-aware), Stage 2 = weighted A/B (5% sample for 48h) where we compare cost/per-token + quality.
Diego: Important: APAC has nightly infra maintenance windows. Canaries must respect blackout windows and schedule only in 02:00-06:00 UTC or weekends.
Hannah: From SRE: safety ladder = (1) auto-fallback routing, (2) regional flag off, (3) global freeze. Automate ladder via ops-bot with runbook links. Also require 3x consecutive 5m windows for a gate trip to avoid flapping.
Owen: Data wants a small live-eval harness: 200 synthetic prompts/hour + 200 sampled user queries/hour. Compute embedding-cosine drift + response-length delta. If embedding drift > 0.03 OR length delta > 20% -> quality gate trip.
Chris: Sample rollout config (pseudo):
```
rollout_name: staged-eu-apac-v1
canary_phase:
  slices:
    - region: eu
      pct: 0.5
    - region: apac
      pct: 0.3
  duration: 6h
ab_phase:
  sample_pct: 5
  duration: 48h
telemetry_gates:
  latency_p95_increase_pct: 35
  error_rate_abs: 0.75
  embedding_drift: 0.03
economics_gates:
  token_cost_increase_pct: 15
  spend_threshold_day: 1000
fallback_order:
  - model: stable-v1
  - flag: rollout.stage.region=0
  - freeze: global
flags:
  key: rollout.staged_eu_apac_v1
  allow_manual_override: true
  per_tenant_opt_in: true
```
Hannah: Add circuit-breaker hysteresis: once tripped, hold fallback for min 10m, require 3 clean windows to re-enable. Log and surface to oncall channel.
Diego: Ops asks: per-tenant rate caps and a token-budget eviction policy. If a tenant hits token budget for the hour, downgrade that tenant to quantized-variant or cached response. Example rule: `if tenant_tokens_used > tenant_budget * 0.95 -> downgrade`
Priya: Customer constraint: enterprise tenants want opt-in for first week and manual approval per-account. Add an onboarding flag and an approval webhook for customer success.
Owen: On metrics: use rolling 5m windows for latency and 1h windows for cost. For A/B, compute ATE on quality metric and cost delta; require p < 0.05 to claim improvement.
Chris: Implementation notes: feature-flag naming convention = rollout.<product>.<region>.<yyyymm>.<variant>. Keep flags immutable for audit; use new flag for any change.
Hannah: Contract tests: ensure function-calling payloads roundtrip with fallback model. Add simple harness: `curl -X POST /test-contract -d '{"payload":...}'` and verify schema + response keys.
Priya: Communications: in-console banner 72h + email 48h. Ops will post a status page link during the canary.
Diego: ops-bot will tag oncall and execute scripted rollbacks. Example rollback snippet:
```
# auto fallback trigger
POST /internal/routing/fallback
{
  "rollout": "staged-eu-apac-v1",
  "action": "route_to",
  "target": "stable-v1"
}
# kill flag
POST /internal/flags/rollout.staged_eu_apac_v1 -d '{"value":0}'
```
ops-bot: Canary kicked: rollout=staged-eu-apac-v1 slice=eu pct=0.5 start=6133334444
Owen: For post-canary: generate a short executive report with latency/cost/quality and a recommendation (pass / continue rollout / rollback). Also include a per-tenant exception list.
Chris: Timeline estimate: 2 sprints for flags+routing+telemetry hooks, 1 sprint for data harness + contract tests, then internal shadow run 1 week; canary early in next sprint.
Priya: Please add blockers to the shared doc by EOD Thursday. We'll lock the rollout config Friday. Thanks. :rocket:
